group_name: Pack Memorial Library LEGO Builders Club
summary: A weekly drop-in LEGO free-build session for grades K-5 run by Pack Memorial Library staff (a Buncombe County public library branch), not a self-organized club. Kids use library-provided bricks; there is no membership, roster, dues, or named leader, and the same event format ('LEGO Builders Club') runs generically across other Buncombe County library branches too.
